QuestInfo.name: Mr. Hazard's Objective
QuestInfo.0: #bConey's#k having trouble with Report X-9. Find out how you can help.
QuestInfo.1: Help Coney with his reagent analysis while he works on Report X-9. He needs #b15 Mutant Nutria Blood#k samples from the #rNutria#k in #bNutria Gutter 2#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the Mutant Nutria Blood and gave it to Coney.

0.0: I've got the first part of the code figured out. I'm still working on the second part, but this bit that keeps repeating bothers me.\r\n
0.1: It's something about a 'reagent.' Cadena, it's the thing we stole from the Brawl 'n' Bash Club.\r\n
0.2: I was still trying to figure out exactly what the reagent is when you called me here. I don't see how I'm supposed to decode documents and analyze chemicals at the same time.\r\n
0.3: C-Cadena, I need your help on this. I'll keep working on the report if you give me a hand with the reagent.\r\n

yes.0: Please get 15 #b#i4036151:# Mutant Nutria Blood#k samples from the #rNutria#k in #bNutria Gutter 2#k. P-please.\r\n
yes.1: It's the key to figuring out the reagent. But... I have a bad feeling about all of this...\r\n

no.0: We don't have much time before Mr. Hazard's men start piecing our plan together...\r\n

1.0: You c-came. I've made some progress on the code! Hurry up and give me that...\r\n

0.msg: Th-thank you. That will do the trick. N-now I'll finish decoding the report and put all the pieces together...\r\n

1.msg: #b(Coney looks over the reagent and the document. His eyes narrow.)#k\r\n

3.msg: According to all this... Mr. Hazard set his sights on this place for a bioweapon: the Heliogene Device...\r\n
